jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois & 7th Circuit

headline: Appeals Court Upholds Conviction of Former Illinois Speaker Who Outsourced Patronage to Electric Utility
deck: The Seventh Circuit affirmed Michael Madigan’s 92-month sentence and $2.5 million fine over ComEd no-show jobs tied to $150 million in bills.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 7.5 years federal prison and $2.5M fine affirmed by the 7th Circuit; ComEd separately paid $200M to resolve its DPA.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Bribing a municipal inspector with $1,800 cash for a building permit
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 24–36 months prison, without a decade of utility-funded no-show subcontracts
